prompts.A: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE original pixel-art station keyframe for Rail Link: Collapse by editing image 1, the 390x844 game screenshot. Image 1 is the exact composition and material style. Image 2 is architecture/mood reference ONLY; do not copy its composition or symbols. Output a single portrait frame with aspect ratio 390:844, ideally exactly 390x844. Keep camera, locomotive, its smoke, three railway tracks, foreground ground and both HUD panels exactly unchanged in position, scale, color and pixels. Do not redesign the locomotive. Preserve timer at upper right. Station architecture occupies y85 through y450 behind and around the train, side elements may continue to y650, never over HUD. Most important architecture must be visible in y100-220 ABOVE locomotive, with its central crown below top HUD. Draw two raised STONE PASSENGER PLATFORMS flush at rail level, flanking all tracks, extending from locomotive backwards into station. On EACH platform put exactly 4 small waiting upright human silhouettes, completely dark plain clothed silhouettes with heads, torsos and legs, no faces or details, spaced and clearly visible beside train, 25-42 screen px tall, not ghostly. Station should immediately read as populated passenger stop. At x330 y260 add heavy cast-iron sign on post bearing ONLY numeral "1", same location as old station sign. Materials match existing dark brown brick and soot-black cast iron. Coarse pixel art with screen pixels 2-3 px per logical pixel, hard stepped outlines, broad quiet stone faces, restrained texture; no fine illustration. Palette limited to these hex colors: 0b0a10 17121b 241a24 33232b 47303a 3a1010 5c3a35 7a4a3a 96604a b07a58 cc9c74 e8d0a8 6a1410 9c1e10 d2340f f0601a f8902a fcc048 fff090 2a3038 465058 6c7880 9aa8ac d0d8d4 1f5a30 2f9a44 6cdc5c 1f4a8c 3a8ae0 8cd4f0 5a2a78 fff8ec. Only flames, lava and door opening themselves emit bright color. NO painted light spilling on surfaces, no glow, no gradients, no fog, no blur, no antialiasing. NO hanging bodies, corpses, blood, crosses, pentagrams, runes, writing, letters, logos. Empty iron cages allowed. Existing HUD digits preserved; station numeral 1 only new text. VARIANT A: THE FURNACE ALTAR. Build a station hall beneath enormous soot-black iron rib arches with jagged spikes over railway; rib crown visible y110-170, layered ribs receding behind train. A stylized horned animal skull ornament at center of arch above railway, around y125, visibly above locomotive smoke. Strong black structural ribs like image 2 mood, but original station design in image 1's pixel medium. Stone pedestals with self-contained braziers on both sides y220-330, narrow lava gutters along outer platform edges. Two EMPTY hanging iron cages, one each upper side, visible as a few thick bars. Clearly exposed waiting passengers on the stone platforms between braziers and train. Keep architecture dark and large-scale with silhouettes readable, no orange sky or pervasive red wash.
